paite: Huan Pathian in huchi a chi in hiai thute tengteng agen hi.
heading: Thupiak Sawm / (Diu 5.1-21)
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Aigupta gam a kipan leh saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi;
english: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

paite: ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

paite: Milim gelhthoh himhim ahihkeileh tunglam van a om thil lim kibatpih mawngmawng hiam nuai lei a om hiam lei nuai a tui sung a om kibatpih na kibawl ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

paite: Akiang uah na kun ding ahi kei, a-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi kei. Kei lah TOUPA na Pathian, mullit hat Pathian, kei hon hote khang thumna leh khang lina tan a, pate gitlouhna tate tung a thuk ka hi ngal a,
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, Yahweh your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

paite: kei hon it a, ka thupiakte zuite lak a sang tampite kiang a zahngaihna lak zelpa ka hi.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian min na mawk gen ding ahi kei; amin mawk genmi lah TOUPA'N moh lou in akoih ngal kei a.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of Yahweh your God, for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

paite: Sabbath ni siangthou a tan ding theigige in.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

paite: Ni guk sung teng nna na sem ding a, na nna tengteng nasep ding ahi.
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

paite: Himahleh ani sagihna TOUPA na Pathian Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ah nna himhim; nang leng, na tapa in leng, na tanu in leng, na sikhapa hiam, na sikhanu hiam, na ganta hiam, na huangsung a om na mikhual hiam in leng asem ding ahi kei.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

paite: Ani guk ni in TOUPA'N lei leh van, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawl in, ani sagih ni in akhawl ngal a. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Sabbath ni vualzawl in, atang siangthou hi.
english: for in six days Yahweh made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore Yahweh blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

paite: Na nu leh na pa zahtak in. TOUPA na Pathian in ahon piak gam a na nite asautheihna ding in.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

paite: Tual na that ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not murder.

paite: Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

paite: Na gu ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not steal.

paite: Na inveng siatna ding in palai taklou na hi ding ahi kei.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

paite: Na inveng inn na eng ding ahi kei. Na inveng zi na eng ding ahi kei, asikhapa leng, asikhanu leng, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, thil himhim na inveng a peuhpeuh.
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

paite: Mi tengteng in vanpigingte, khophiate, pengkul husate leh tang kang khu amu ua; mite'n huaite amuh un, akisuan ua, gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
heading: Mite Lauhna / (Diu 5.22-33)
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Ka kiang uah thu gen inla, ka hon ngaikhe ding uhi. Himahleh Pathian in hon houpih kei hen, ka si kha ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Amah launa na ma ua a-om a, na khelhlouhna ding un, noute hon enchian ding a Pathian hong pai ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

paite: Mite gamlatak ah adingh ua, Pathian omna mun mial bikbek lam ah Mosi ava pai nai hi.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Israel kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding, "Van a pan nou ka hon houpih na muta uhi.
heading: Maitam Toh Kisai Dan
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

paite: Kei lou dangka pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Dangka-eng pathiante leng na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

paite: Kei a ding in lei maitam na bawl ding ua, huai ah na halmang thillatte leh na lemna thillatte, na belamte leh na bawngtalte na lan ding uh ahi. Mun tengteng a ka min ka khumna ah na kiang uah ka hong dia, ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

paite: Suang maitam na hon bawlsakleh, suangsek a na bawl louh ding ahi. Suang tung a na vanzat na likleh, na hihnin ahi ngal a.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

paite: Huai a na vuaktanna adawklouhna ding in, ka maitam ah kalbi in na kahtou ding ahi kei," achi hi.
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’
